final: WITH matched AS (SELECT m.link_to_major COLLATE BINARY AS major_id, a.department COLLATE BINARY AS department FROM member AS m JOIN major AS a ON m.link_to_major COLLATE BINARY = a.major_id COLLATE BINARY), grouped AS (SELECT major_id, department, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM matched GROUP BY major_id, department), shares AS (SELECT major_id, department, group_count, CAST(group_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(group_count) OVER (), 0) AS group_share FROM grouped), dept_avgs AS (SELECT department, AVG(group_share) AS dept_avg FROM shares GROUP BY department) SELECT s.major_id, s.department, s.group_count, s.group_share, s.group_share - d.dept_avg AS share_minus_dept_avg FROM shares AS s JOIN dept_avgs AS d ON s.department COLLATE BINARY = d.department COLLATE BINARY WHERE s.group_share > d.dept_avg ORDER BY share_minus_dept_avg DESC LIMIT 10
